qualification_handling: Reviewer qualification fields are not sent. Some state the expected defect and are not source evidence. Every verified_evidence item is sent unchanged and in frozen order.
hhem_template:
<pad> Determine if the hypothesis is true given the premise?

Premise: {evidence_document}

Hypothesis: {atomic_claim}
identical_semantic_content: Both candidates receive the same evidence IDs/text and the same atomic claim. Only the documented model wrapper differs.
chunking: No chunking. Any complete formatted input above 1024 tokens stops the affected candidate before scoring.
complete_coverage_record: The runner saves the exact formatted input SHA-256, evidence IDs, tokenizer count and truncation=false for every attempted logical evaluation.
